title: Vasanthakala Paravai
desc: Ravi, a shopkeeper, falls in love with Uma, a student, who belongs to a rich family. But their relationship is tested when Uma's brother decides to intervene and break their bond.

title: Sullaan
desc: Sullan is a college student who only wants to enjoy life. He meets Soori, a moneylender who troubles his family members and friends. Unable to see their pain, Sullan decides to teach Soori a lesson.

title: Kaviya Thalaivan
desc: Manikkam saves a rich man's life who, in return, offers him a job. However, problems ensue when the man's granddaughter, who hates Manikkam, accuses him of misbehaving with her.

title: Thaana Serndha Kootam
desc: After corruption prevents an ambitious man from becoming an investigating officer, he forms a team to impersonate investigation officers and raid corrupt officials.
